ideal: A unit is used exactly when another unit sits in it, a pointer names it, or a tag names it.
An expected failure that checks neither a bug nor an exception is reported as unexplained.
When a run asks for a command that is not available, the run exits with code 2.
A document that extends another is context for it. Context is transitive through extension.
An axiom that cites a non-axiom is reported as misnesting.
When a run gets code 2 from a plugin, the run exits with code 2.

A frontmatter with any of these flaws is refused: an entry starting with @ outside quotes, an undefined key, an unclosed list, an unclosed string, a duplicated key, a dangling path, a looping extension, or a misplaced setting.
A miscited unit is reported as misnesting.
A run that gets code 1 from a plugin but not code 2 from any plugin exits with code 1.
A unit is unfounded exactly when it is one of these: a spec that cites no axiom and no spec, an exception that cites no spec or no fact, or a bug that cites no spec.
note: Kept list structure from current words

ideal: A term that cites a unit is reported as misnesting.
A conflict that names an issue the tracker does not know is reported as mistracking.
When units share a word, the analyzer is asked about them together.
A search asked before any scenario is known impossible leaves no unit out.
A generated statement whose formula would say exactly the same and whose formula can be said in words is current.
A formula that is lone on a signature and is held by a non-term unit is reported as lone on the signature.
note: Clarified 'Logical and u not in Term' as non-term

ideal: There exists a list with a clause about a pair of variables and an item that is more than one clause.
A unit holding a formula with no keyword asks the analyzer to hold the formula.
A bug that cites a non-spec is reported as misnesting.
When a logic command is asked and either a scenario is reported impossible or a unit is held with others that cannot all hold, the run does not exit with code 0.
For an impossible scenario with held units and no author probes, each held unit requires a trial search that makes the scenario possible.
A rule that is not on one line has its "then" on a line of its own.
A list with an item that is more than one clause is said as bullets.
Cleanup never runs on behalf of a call after pulse has disposed an owner, and disposal never throws.
A definition with "and" beside another alternative is said as its alternatives stand.
For each impossible scenario, each unit whose removal frees it is named in the scenario's report.
There exists a quantifier whose variable has a condition and has nothing else to attach.
A declared word that no claim, definition, or fact uses is unused.
When two documents differ only in frontmatter, they hold the same units and their finding status matches.
A quantifier with multiple conditions where one begins with a time phrase is said in full, with "there is" and the numbered name.
When a run asks for an unavailable command, that command is reported as unknown and the run exits with code 2.
When two documents differ only in frontmatter, they either both have findings or neither does.
A scenario that can happen is not reported as impossible.
note: Removed redundant 'while every held unit holds'

ideal: A word used in one unit but declared in another is apart.
A definition whose alternatives are all of one kind and can be said kind by kind is said as one sentence.
A list with an item containing a comma and more than two clauses is said as bullets.
A document that holds units but no index is reported as misindexed.
A word that is undeclared, misplaced, apart, or unused is flagged.
A list with a relative clause before its last clause is said as bullets.
